review:
Better than the second one, though I don't remember the first well enough to say if it's on par with or superior to that one.

The settings and cinematography in some scenes are quite interesting and striking. I also found the characters, while a bit caricatured, to be entertaining and driven by solid motivations.

The mystery and its ultimate resolution are truly unconventional and hard to guess. I felt that the constant stream of revelations and partial solutions leading up to the end became a bit exhausting, like a prolonged period of "edging" before the climax. However, the fact that the final solution is so complete and well-integrated makes the wait worthwhile.
